scope: General government only: Census utilities (including transit systems), liquor stores and insurance trusts are left out of revenue and spending. Per-resident values are fiscal 2022 dollars over 2023 residents.

calibration.basis: NASBO fiscal 2025 all-funds state spending divided by Census 2022 state expenditure, summed across the 50 states. It carries 2022 amounts to the game's opening year and is a calibration, not a price index.
